new_value: Fully accounted for. A fresh --all-features sweep of pkix-identity reports 164 mutants, 3 missed, and all three are explained rather than open: lib.rs:116 is a const-block compile-time assertion the build discharges; lib.rs:485's disjunction is refused again downstream by validate_ascii_local_part and normalize_dns_name, so no input distinguishes the forms; lib.rs:897's RFC 8398 guard decides nothing, because der refuses any byte above 0x7F when decoding an IA5String, so an rfc822Name's local-part is always ASCII and an internationalized target's never is -- established by decoding a hand-built rfc822Name carrying UTF-8 bytes and recorded in a source comment in c82fbc8b. The other 24 were closed in 19f75de3.
